name: search_ads
title: Search ad libraries
description: Search the Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn and Google ad libraries at once for live and recent ads by keyword, advertiser name or website domain. Returns ad copy, creative links, start dates, placements, reach and landing pages, plus a search_id for Save Ad. Uses one search from your plan; repeating a search within 12 hours is served from cache.

query.description: Keyword, advertiser name or website domain, for example running shoes, Allbirds or allbirds.com

mode.description: Defaults to domain for a domain and keyword otherwise. Google supports advertiser and domain only.

platforms.description: Ad libraries to search. Default: all four.

country.description: Two-letter country code for Meta, LinkedIn and Google. Default: all countries.

name: get_usage
title: Get plan and usage
description: Your Adlane plan, searches used and left, and board, saved-ad and competitor limits. Does not use a search.

name: list_boards
title: List boards
description: Your boards (saved-ad collections) with ad counts.

name: get_board
title: Get a board
description: The ads saved on one board, with your notes.

boardId.description: Board ID from Get Many or Create

name: create_board
title: Create a board
description: Create a board for saved ads. Counts toward your plan's board limit.

name: save_ad
title: Save an ad to a board
description: Save one ad from a Search result to a board, with an optional note. Counts toward your plan's saved-ad limit; does not use a search.

boardId.description: Board ID from Get Many or Create

ad_key.description: ad_key of one ad in that search

note.description: Optional note saved with the ad

annotations.title: Save an ad to a board

name: list_competitors
title: List tracked competitors
description: Tracked competitors with how many ads Adlane has seen and how many are new since you last looked in the app.

name: track_competitor
title: Track a competitor
description: Start tracking a competitor by name (and website domain for Google). Adlane checks their ads now and paid plans recheck every 24 hours. Counts toward your plan's competitor limit; on Free the first check uses one of the 5 free searches.

domain.description: Website domain, needed for Google, for example allbirds.com

platforms.description: Ad libraries to watch. Default: all four.
